title: Billing Department Statement: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Deposit Release and Credit Adjustments at Enrollment
content:
**Deposit release.** At enrollment in PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), a security deposit held on the enrolled service account is released in the order the program prescribes: it is applied first against the arrears that would otherwise be transferred, and only the remainder is credited to the prepaid balance as a deposit credit whose source is the deposit record. Deposit interest accrued to that day is paid out under the Security Deposits rules, not here.

**Arrears transfers.** Arrears transfers at enrollment follow the PrePay Power member-portfolio basis for measuring and transferring arrears.

**Retired clause.** The clause "A credit adjustment is posted only for a daily charge line shown to be wrong (billing error correction), a meter found fast on test (meter error refund), an estimated day later trued up by an actual read (estimated read correction), or a standard-billing credit balance carried in at enrollment (carried-in standard-billing credit), for the difference only and once per source record" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current bases for carrying a credit balance into an enrollment and for meter error refunds.

### Deposit release illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

| Arrears that would otherwise be transferred | Deposit held on the enrolled account | Applied against arrears | Arrears left to transfer | Deposit credit to the prepaid balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100.00 | 150.00 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 |
| 400.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | none |
| 0.00 | 150.00 | none | 0.00 | 150.00 |

superseded_clauses: A credit adjustment is posted only for a daily charge line shown to be wrong (billing_error_correction), a meter found fast on test (meter_error_refund), an estimated day later trued up by an actual read (estimated_read_correction), or a standard-billing credit balance carried in at enrollment (postpaid_credit_transfer), for the difference only and once per source record.
